name: Endform
description: Run existing Playwright end-to-end suites in parallel on isolated cloud machines, and let coding agents query test history and rerun or debug tests over MCP, for QA teams.

skills.name: Run Test Suite
skills.description: Starts, checks and stops runs of a Playwright suite on Endform's remote machines from the CLI or an MCP tool call.

skills.name: Query Test History
skills.description: Queries historical test data to find flaky, failing and slow tests and to inspect past runs and traces.

skills.name: Debug Test Live
skills.description: Starts a live session that runs a single Playwright test on Endform's remote infrastructure so an agent can debug it.

skills.name: Manage Quarantine
skills.description: Lists, creates, updates and deactivates quarantine rules so known flaky tests stop blocking the suite.

skills.name: Replay Test Attempt
skills.description: Inspects a single test attempt and returns a replay link so you can step through what happened in that run.
